resources.string: Open Settings > Battery, find UltimateAlarm and allow background activity; do not let the system optimise or restrict it.
Open Settings > Apps > Auto launch (or App management > Auto launch) and turn UltimateAlarm on.
Open recent apps, long-press UltimateAlarm (or swipe down on it) and choose “Lock” so the system does not close it.
Allow full-screen notifications and “Show on lock screen” for UltimateAlarm, so the alarm appears while the phone is locked.
Open Settings > Battery > Background usage limits. Remove UltimateAlarm from “Sleeping apps” and “Deep sleeping apps” and add it to “Never sleeping apps”.
Samsung has no separate auto-start list: it is enough for UltimateAlarm to be in “Never sleeping apps”.
In recent apps, tap UltimateAlarm’s icon and choose “Keep open” so it is not closed.
Allow full-screen notifications for UltimateAlarm (the app’s notification settings).
Open Settings > Apps > Manage apps > UltimateAlarm > Battery saver and choose “No restrictions”.
Open Security > Permissions > Autostart (or the app’s settings > Autostart) and turn UltimateAlarm on.
In recent apps, long-press UltimateAlarm and tap the padlock to lock it.
In the app’s “Other permissions”, allow “Show on lock screen” and “Display pop-up windows while running in the background”.
Open Settings > Battery > Background power consumption (or i Manager > Power management) and allow UltimateAlarm high background power use.
Open i Manager > App management > Autostart (or Settings > Apps > Permissions > Autostart) and turn UltimateAlarm on.
In recent apps, swipe down on UltimateAlarm to lock it.
Allow full-screen notifications and “Show on lock screen” for UltimateAlarm.
Open Settings > Battery > App launch (or Power management), find UltimateAlarm and choose to manage it manually with everything on.
In App launch, turn off “Manage automatically” for UltimateAlarm and turn on auto-launch, secondary launch and run in background.
In recent apps, swipe down on UltimateAlarm to lock it.
Allow full-screen and lock-screen notifications for UltimateAlarm.
Let UltimateAlarm ignore battery optimisation: show “All apps”, find UltimateAlarm and choose “Don’t optimise”.
Not needed on this phone: Android does not restrict auto-start.
Not needed on this phone: alarms keep working even if you close the app.
Allow full-screen notifications for UltimateAlarm so the alarm appears over the lock screen (Android 14 and later).
Find the battery or power settings, look for UltimateAlarm and exclude it from battery optimisation and background restrictions.
If your phone has an auto-start list (often under Security or Apps), turn UltimateAlarm on.
If your phone lets you lock apps in the recents view, lock UltimateAlarm.
Allow UltimateAlarm to show full-screen notifications and over the lock screen, so the alarm appears while the phone is locked.
